properties.project_name: UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay
properties.digitized_from: OpenStreetMap (way 580277612, name=UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay, amenity=hospital, operator=University of California San Francisco, 1975 4th St)
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint for the main hospital complex, which houses UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital, UCSF Bakar Cancer Hospital and Betty Irene Moore Women's Hospital under one roof.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 at 675 Nelson Rising Lane alone is ~13 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: 289-bed hospital complex (183-bed Benioff Children's Hospital, 36-bed Betty Irene Moore Women's Hospital, 70-bed Bakar Cancer Hospital), ~878,000 sq ft, ~$1.52 billion project cost. Architect of record Anshen+Allen (later absorbed into Stantec), design collaborator William McDonough + Partners. Opened Feb 1, 2015 after ~10 years of planning and 5 years of construction.
